newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians march to press Israel to free inmates.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians march to press Israel to free inmates.

text.p: Holding pictures of relatives in Israeli jails, about 200 Palestinian women and children marched in a peaceful demonstration in Gaza City on Monday demanding their release, witnesses said.
"Prisoners suffer from terrible conditions and some are now on hunger strike," Intisar al-Wazir, minister of social welfare in the Palestinian Authority, said during the protest.

Despite peace agreements that gave the Palestine Liberation Organisation control over the lives of most Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, human rights groups say Israel is still holding about 5,000 Arabs in jails inside its territory.
Israel freed some of the prisoners, jailed for resisting Israeli occupation, following a self-rule deal signed last year and agreed to discuss releasing others.
Prisoners relatives said they had been facing difficulties visiting inmates in Israeli jails because of Israeli closures imposed frequently on the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
"Peace without freeing the prisoners is not peace," said Um Mahmoud, a mother who had not seen her 23-year-old son Mahmoud for three months.
